newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Against the trend to N.Z..
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Against the trend to N.Z..

text.p: The Australian debt market gave up some ground to the U.S. and Canada after Thursday's sharp tightening on a weaker than expected employment report, but continued to outpace New Zealand.

The N.Z. market reversed an early rally after the RBNZ issued its second warning in eight days that monetary conditions were too loose, which came on top of a larger than expected current account deficit of NZ$4.5 billion for the year to March.

The local market saw some pre-weekend book squaring ahead of the U.S. PPI later on Friday which saw yields edge higher, but the underlying tone remains firm in anticipation of a further monetary policy easing by the Reserve Bank in the coming weeks, analysts said.
